block.text: Genetic Optimization Loop: Given an AI system Φ , the goal is to identify parameters Π that maximize Φ task performance. GEPA begins with a candidate pool P containing only the base system, where each can- didate is a concrete instantiation of ⟨ Π , Θ ⟩ . It then enters an optimization loop, repeatedly proposing f rozen Φ new candidates until the evaluation budget is exhausted. Candidates are derived from existing ones via re- flective mutation or crossover , guided by feedback from rollouts, with each inheriting learning signals from its parents and its own rollout so that GEPA accumulates knowledge along the genetic tree.
